rows.test: formal review (R3) command: placeholders expand, the prompt is passed in argv when {instructions} is present and on stdin otherwise, the verdict schema is materialised
rows.evidence: Commit `77b57457` (T1-SWEEP-REVIEW-WRAPPERS) moved `runPreReview` out of `src/review/pre-review.ts` into `tests/surface/_review-once.ts:31-37`, because no code in `src/` had called it since the R2 panel (`a7bbcaee`). The argv and stdin arms at `tests/surface/pre-review.test.ts:217-223` (`argv mode closes stdin` at :220) call `runPreReview`, so they check the test copy at `tests/surface/_review-once.ts:36`, not the spawn the loop runs at `src/review/pre-review.ts:1330` (`runReviewPanel`, used for R3 by `src/loop/card-runner.ts`). The `expandCommand` and schema assertions of the same test read `src/` and stay valid. Uncovered: no other test asserts the stdin of an argv-mode reviewer spawn (`grep` for `input` assertions on reviewer runners under `tests/`).

rows.test: panel: perspectives run concurrently with their own prompt section and files, the round verdict aggregates quota > block > no-verdict > pass, and a non-zero exit never passes
rows.evidence: Same move (`77b57457`). The arm at `tests/surface/pre-review.test.ts:314-316` (`argv instructions force shell=false`) calls `runPreReview`, so it checks `tests/surface/_review-once.ts:36`; the loop's own rule, that argv instructions never go through a shell, is `src/review/pre-review.ts:1330` and no test reaches it. The other arms of this test call `runReviewPanel` and stay valid. Uncovered: no test asserts `shell` false for a `runReviewPanel` spawn with `{instructions}`.

rows.test: T0-REVIEWER-UTF8 acceptance 2: runPreReview and every angle of runReviewPanel spawn the reviewer with reviewerEnv() [R2]
rows.evidence: The test came with `c8a239d5` (T0-REVIEWER-UTF8, #107), when `runPreReview` was in `src/`; `77b57457` (#156) moved it to `tests/surface/_review-once.ts`. The two `runPreReview` calls at `tests/surface/reviewer-env.test.ts:61-62` now check the test copy's `env: reviewerEnv()` (`tests/surface/_review-once.ts:36`). Covered by the `runReviewPanel` arm of this same test (`tests/surface/reviewer-env.test.ts:63`), which reaches `src/review/pre-review.ts:1330`.

rows.test: renderPlan light omits the ten-section skeleton; full includes it
rows.evidence: Commit `9d856614` (T1-SWEEP2-TEST-ONLY) moved `renderPlan` from `src/artifacts/plan.ts` into the fixture file `tests/surface/_artifacts.ts:47` ("only tests called them"). The test at `tests/surface/plan.test.ts:29-40` asserts only the text `renderPlan` writes and calls no `src/` function, so it tests a fixture. The plan skeleton the product installs is `templates/plans/_TEMPLATE.md`, which this test does not read. Uncovered: the skeleton assertions (a light plan has no `## 1. Goal and boundaries`; a full plan has `## 1. Goal and boundaries`, `none this version`, `## 7. Task split` and `## 10. After merge`). The readiness test (`:42`) and the parsePlanCards test (`:122`) do not cover them: with headings 1 and 10 removed from the fixture, readiness still answers `admit` and the parsed cards are the same (R3 decision 1, F2). The update is to assert the skeleton against `templates/plans/_TEMPLATE.md` or to fold the fixture checks into the tests that use it.
